result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but one visible rendering defect stands out: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' restaurant title is clipped mid-character, showing a partially cut-off letter with no ellipsis, even though this is not a scrollable-edge situation.

issues.description: The restaurant title in the 'Popular right now' section reads 'Tokumaru Rameı' — the final 'n' is clipped mid-glyph rather than being truncated cleanly with an ellipsis. There appears to be free horizontal space between the title and the rating badge, so the hard clipping looks like a layout/measurement bug rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title label to use the available width up to the rating element, and if truncation is still needed, apply proper ellipsis truncation (e.g., text-overflow: ellipsis / TextOverflow.ellipsis) instead of clipping characters mid-glyph.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button on the Tokumaru Ramen card sits on a transparent background over a busy image, while the one on the pizza card below has a dark circular backdrop — the styling is inconsistent between cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent semi-opaque circular backdrop behind the favorite icon on all cards to ensure visibility and visual consistency.
